svg.title: One Gerstner wave: points move on orbits
svg.desc: Side view of a single Gerstner wave. Each green point is a vertex moving around its own circle; the blue line through the points has sharper crests and flatter troughs than the dashed sine of the same height.
svg.text: One Gerstner wave: points move on orbits
Each vertex is pushed around an ellipse: Q·A wide, A tall.
Here Q = 1, so the ellipses are circles (k·A ≈ 0.63, exaggerated).
Dashed line: a plain sine of the same height, for comparison.
